_comment: Overlay on packages/maker/config/default.json for the Cloudflare Worker. MON is the bottleneck (testnet faucet; Monad bills the gas limit). QUOTING budget (dailyCapMon.maker 1.2 MON per Taipei day) with tiers: above softRatio 60 % (0.72 MON) the spreads widen x2 and only urgent re-quotes go out; at the cap no new quotes, an urgent strike is pulled. Pulls, the kill switch, the YES-margin withdraw and the stale void are on a separate reserve meter and are NEVER refused (reserveMon is only the alert line). The shared lazy re-quote policy (default.json policy.lazy: fair move 0.04, 2 h stale refresh with 0.02 move, one-sided refills) applies to both runtimes. Replay of the Oct 8, Oct 9 and Oct 10 ladders (evidence/lazy-replay-2026-10-09): the old settings re-quoted 88 times a day (~5.6 MON of quoting); the lazy rules alone 64 (~4.2, most re-quotes are urgent crossings); with the 1.2 MON tiers 16 (~1.2 + 0.24 pulls), about 2.8 MON/day all-in with a 4-strike roll (1.0 cap ~2.6, 1.5 cap ~3.0). The roll has its own meter (rollCapMon) so quoting can never starve the next day's roll (the 2026-10-08 incident) and rolls at most 4 strikes nearest the Polymarket median, skipping any whose implied P(>=k) is outside [0.05, 0.95]. treasury: the automatic top-up of the role keys from a dedicated treasury key (src/treasury.ts); addresses are public. Vars in wrangler.toml (STATIONS, RPC_URLS) and CONFIG_OVERRIDES override this file.
